fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (g0042, near 0x710068ae48) stores vptr 0x7104f72fc0; module stored at boma+0x108. Reflector (0x7104f72fc0) and Absorber (0x7104f731f0) share almost the whole vtable (common shield base, same functions for every exported slot); they differ in the destructor (+0x8) and slots +0x200..+0x210 and after.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the boma beside the vptr; get_team_no (+0x150) tail-calls TeamModule (boma+0xD8) vtable +0x50 through it; setup (+0x28) reads the owner battle object id at boma+0x8.

fields.name: group_num
fields.evidence: get_group_num (+0x1A8) returns the 64-bit value. Setup slot +0x28 (f_71004c4d70) copies it with the groups pointer from the resource descriptor (desc+0x18/+0x20). clean (+0x50) and clear_all (+0x188) loop over this many groups.

fields.name: groups
fields.evidence: Array of group records, stride 0x34, indexed by the group argument of almost every exported method; set by setup from desc+0x20.

fields.name: shape_num
fields.evidence: Copied by setup from desc+0x8 together with +0x28; zeroed by the constructor and by slot +0x30 (f_71004c4fd0, teardown).

fields.name: shapes
fields.evidence: Array of per-part shape records, stride 0x50, index = group.first_shape (i16 at group+0x4) + part. set_size, set_status, set_shield_type, is_shield and slot +0x168 address it.

fields.name: active_shape_count
fields.evidence: Zeroed by constructor, setup and clean; incremented by slots +0x58/+0x60 (f_71004c5780/f_71004c5930) when a shape is added to the collision list.

fields.name: collision_list_node
fields.evidence: Embedded list/registration object (0x38..0x47): slot +0x1C8 returns its address (this+0x38); clean calls a helper on it; update slot +0x80 registers it (f_71003e6440) the first time a group is live and then sets +0x7C.

fields.name: collision_group_num
fields.evidence: Copied by setup from desc+0x28 with +0x50; loops in the activation reset (+0x38), sleep (+0x1D0) and slot +0x40 run over it.

fields.name: collision_groups
fields.evidence: Array of collision-group records, stride 0x2D0, indexed by group.collision_group (i32 at group+0x0); each holds shape-object pointers at +0x30+8*part. get_center_pos (+0x198) calls shape->vfunc(+0x20) and returns its 16-byte vector; set_target_property/set_target_category rewrite masks in those shape objects. Unexported slot +0x1F8 writes a u64 at record+0x2C8.

fields.name: active_group_end
fields.evidence: Highest live group index + 1: set_status raises it to group+1 when a non-zero status is set; the per-frame update (+0x80) recomputes it; clean and the activation reset zero it; setup initialises it to the collision group count (low 32 bits of desc+0x28).

fields.name: shield_kind
fields.evidence: Constructor -1; setup copies desc+0x0. The activation reset and the add-shape slots set bit (1<<kind) & 0x7F in each shape object's attribute word and special-case kinds 3 and 4 (different second mask). Distinguishes the kind of shield collision (reflector / absorber / shield...).

fields.name: owner_object_id
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x50000000 (invalid id); setup and the activation reset store the owner battle object id (boma+0x8).

fields.name: owner_category
fields.evidence: Constructor 6; setup stores owner_object_id >> 28 (battle object category nibble).

fields.name: team_info
fields.evidence: Setup stores the result of TeamModule (boma+0xD8) vtable +0x48; constructor 0.

fields.name: flag_0x70
fields.evidence: Constructor zeroes 0x70..0x73 (u32 store); no exported method reads 0x70 itself.

fields.name: no_team
fields.evidence: set_no_team (export calls slot +0x158, f_71004c61d0) stores arg&1.

fields.name: flag_0x72
fields.evidence: Zeroed by constructor and setup.

fields.name: target_category_shift
fields.evidence: Constructor 6; setup copies desc+0x4. The activation reset uses (0x80 << this) & 0x1F80 as the default target-category mask written into each shape object (the same bit field set_target_category writes).

fields.name: is_registered
fields.evidence: Set by the per-frame update (+0x80) after registering the collision node (+0x38); cleared by slot +0x48 (f_71004c56f0) and the activation reset (16-bit zero of 0x7C/0x7D).

fields.name: is_hit
fields.evidence: Set in slot +0x170 (f_71004c6240, the hit-check pass) when a group detects a hit; slots +0x178 / +0x180 return early (false) unless set. Constructor 0, reset with +0x7C.

fields.name: flag_0x7e
fields.evidence: Constructor 1; slot +0x40 (f_71004c54d0) does its collision-group pass only when set.

fields.name: is_sleep
fields.evidence: sleep (export calls slot +0x1D0, f_71004c6cd0) stores arg&1 after walking the collision groups when the value changes. is_shield (+0x88) returns false while set; update (+0x80) does nothing while set; activation reset clears it.

fields.name: attack_limit_mul
fields.evidence: Constructor 1.0, activation reset 1.0; unexported setter slot +0x128 stores s0. get_attack_limit (+0x120) returns group.attack_limit * this.

fields.name: hit_stop_mul
fields.evidence: set_hit_stop_mul (+0x130) stores s0, unexported getter +0x138 loads it. Constructor 1.0.

fields.name: hit_info
fields.evidence: 0x88..0xAF: a record slot +0x1C8 returns by address (this+0x88). Reset by constructor/setup/activation reset to: +0x88 u32 0x50000000, +0x8C u8 6, +0x90 i32 -1, +0x94 u32 0x50000000, +0x98 u8 6, +0x9C/+0xA0 i32 -1, +0xA4/+0xA8 u32 0x50000000, +0xAC i32 -1 (object ids, categories and indices of the last object hit / hitting; filled by the hit pass).

fields.name: flag_0xb0
fields.evidence: Unexported setter slot +0x1E0 stores arg&1, getter +0x1E8 returns it. Constructor 0.

fields.name: group.collision_group
fields.evidence: Index into collision_groups (stride 0x2D0) used by get_center_pos and set_target_*; clean sets -1.

fields.name: group.first_shape
fields.evidence: Base index into shapes for this group's parts; clean sets -1.

fields.name: group.part_size
fields.evidence: get_part_size (+0x148) returns it; set_status_all, clear_all and set_target_* loop over this many parts. clean sets 0.

fields.name: group.pos_x
fields.evidence: get_pos_x (+0x1B0) loads it; the activation reset writes s0/s1/s2 to +0x8/+0xC/+0x10.

fields.name: group.pos_y
fields.evidence: Written together with pos_x and lr by the activation reset; no exported getter.

fields.name: group.lr
fields.evidence: get_lr (+0x1A0) loads it as a float.

fields.name: group.hop_angle
fields.evidence: get_hop_angle (+0xC0) loads it; set_hop (export -> slot +0xE0) stores the angle with the hop flag.

fields.name: group.attack_mul
fields.evidence: get_attack_mul (+0xF0) / set_attack_mul (+0xE8). clean sets 1.0. Read by ReflectModule's reflect event handler.

fields.name: group.speed_mul
fields.evidence: get_speed_mul (+0x100) / set_speed_mul (+0xF8). clean sets 1.0.

fields.name: group.attack_limit
fields.evidence: set_attack_limit (+0x118) stores s0; get_attack_limit (+0x120) multiplies by +0x80. clean sets 0.

fields.name: group.life_mul
fields.evidence: get_life_mul (+0x110) / set_life_mul (+0x108). clean sets 0.

fields.name: group.front
fields.evidence: set_front (+0xD8) stores its int arg as a byte (a shield-front kind); is_front (+0xB0) returns != 0.

fields.name: group.hop
fields.evidence: is_hop (+0xB8) returns it; set_hop (slot +0xE0) stores arg&1 and the hop angle.

fields.name: group.turn
fields.evidence: is_turn (+0xA8) returns it; set_turn (export -> slot +0xD0) stores arg&1.

fields.name: group.no_m_ball
fields.evidence: is_no_m_ball (+0x140) returns it (no exported setter).

fields.name: group.no_hop
fields.evidence: is_no_hop (+0xC8) returns it.

fields.name: group.active_part_end
fields.evidence: set_status raises it to part+1 when a non-zero status is set; clean and the activation reset zero it.

fields.name: shape.size
fields.evidence: set_size (+0x90, args part, group, s0) stores the float.

fields.name: shape.shield_type
fields.evidence: set_shield_type (+0x160) stores its first int arg as a byte; unexported getter slot +0x168 returns it.

fields.name: shape.status
fields.evidence: set_status (+0x98) stores it; set_status_all loops set_status over part_size; clear_all (+0x188, every group) and clear_all_2 (+0x190, one group) write 0; the activation reset writes 0. is_shield (+0x88) = !is_sleep && status != 0 (0 = off).

pointers.to: collision group records[collision_group_num], stride 0x2D0 (shape object pointers at +0x30+8*part)

notes: Setup slot +0x28 (f_71004c4d70) takes a resource descriptor and fills groups/shapes/collision groups from it (desc+0x0 kind -> +0x5C, +0x4 -> +0x78, +0x8/+0x10 -> +0x20/+0x28, +0x18/+0x20 -> +0x10/+0x18, +0x28/+0x30 -> +0x48/+0x50). Slot +0x38 (f_71004c5280) is the activation reset (takes a position x/y/lr in s0..s2 and rewrites every group's position and default masks). In paths, 'group*0x34' and '(group.first_shape+part)*0x50' are indexed record steps. get_team_no (+0x150) is not a field: it tail-calls TeamModule (boma+0xD8) vtable +0x50. get_center_pos (+0x198) returns a vector computed by the collision shape object. set_target_property (+0x1B8) and set_target_category (+0x1C0) store nothing in the module: they rewrite bit fields in the collision shape objects (+0xC bits 24..26 from 0x1000000<<arg; +0x8 bits 7..12 from 0x80<<arg). The reflector's per-group attack_mul/speed_mul/life_mul/attack_limit and the owner's team are what ReflectModule copies into a projectile when it reflects it.
